description: Faida helps owner-operators and small carriers sanity-check load offers and delay claims before they commit. Enter lane, mileage, offer, fuel, hours, readiness, broker trust, or detention facts; Faida returns cost-based guidance, caveats, and concise broker wording. It is a decision aid, not a load board or paperwork intake.
